title: Rabbi Chinena, Father of Bar Yeshita
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman identifies him as the one mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Megillah, chapter 4, end of halakhah 10, where Rabbi Abbahu spoke in his name; he describes his son Yeshita as Rabbi Abbahu’s spokesman (amora).

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:10 calls Bar Yashita the spokesman of Rabbi Acha and names Chinena as his father. Hyman instead names Rabbi Abbahu and calls the son Yeshita while the heading has Bar Yeshita. The teacher and name-form attachment remain unresolved; no identity is merged.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. II, p. 472) names Rabbi Abbahu, as does Penei Moshe’s commentary. Guggenheimer’s text names Rabbi Acha and distinguishes what came from Bar Yashita’s father, cited as “Father,” from what did not, cited in Rabbi Chinena’s name. The distinction leaves the father’s personal name unconfirmed by this passage.
